cases: capability: only the exact bootstrap shape is available, and malformed means unavailable
browser capability needs a secure context, getUserMedia and the capture module; reading never prompts
response text is exact, bounded and never trimmed; shape failures refuse
refusals never assume JSON: nginx 413, route codes, shared report refusals and bare statuses
unavailable by default and with a browser that cannot capture: pressing does nothing
record -> stop -> one bounded request -> review; the report is untouched until Insert
cancel in every phase releases everything and writes nothing; late answers are dropped
study switch and A->B->A end the session through refresh(); the late 200 is never inserted
outside review a changed base or a newly blocked editor releases the microphone at once
a lost connection closes an open microphone but never costs a reviewed transcript
automatic capture cap sends once without Stop and says so
permission refusal and a device ending while stopping each count as ONE failure (callback + rejection)
zero captured frames maps to a user message, not a transport attempt
server and transport failures end in failed with the report unchanged
plain 401 fails only the run; the client timeout aborts and a late answer is ignored
an edited field keeps the text, needs an explicit re-pin, and never inserts on re-pin alone
changed base, study or editor gate at Insert refuses and invalidates; nothing is written
a save in flight is transient; a refused or throwing write fails closed
capability withdrawn mid-recording and page exit both release; cleanup failure is reported
a second Dictate press while the first is starting starts nothing
preparation pauses recording and resumes it with the same edit pin
preparation during upload resumes from owned RAM audio and never accepts the old result
preparation during microphone acquisition resumes the owned device without another permission request
coded session end drops a pending upload and releases all recording resources
Insert returns its result and emits completion after its own editor write
a study change during the start hash releases the owned start flag
HD06 read-only report disables Insert and preserves review without a failed outcome
the module loads in plain Node and publishes the same object on window
the SHIPPED catalog is usable: the form is live and every item renders its own sentence
an item of every body field is reachable, and the two typed items carry machine-readable values
renderItem reproduces every shared vector byte for byte
validateValue refuses every shared invalid vector and accepts every valid one
every shared catalog vector gets exactly the rule it names, on this side too
every shared entry vector is decided by validateValue, before anything is sent
an illegal catalog closes the form instead of throwing, and says which rule
a valid EMPTY catalog is silent, and is not the same thing as a refused one
programming errors are not swallowed by the fail-closed path
a sparse array hole is refused with a rule, not with a TypeError
the PRODUCT catalog is byte-for-byte the pinned canonical JSON
the shipped free-text items refuse at the byte, and the page says where the limit really is
a value that is too long or not one line is refused before anything is sent
placePlan is the U6 primitive itself, not a second implementation
replacePlan swaps exactly one occurrence in place and deletes nothing else
replacePlan places instead when the old line is already gone, and refuses when it is doubled
replacePlan refuses inside a cited block rather than cutting it
samePlan is what makes a stale confirmation impossible
an entry written under another catalog revision is read-only, never re-rendered
the keep list is absent until the dedicated read confirmed it
an unknown answer is stored as unknown, not as none
emptied drops only my draft entries, forget drops the row
liveEntries is head union my draft, and the immutable head wins on a sid collision
GATE-01 before a session is confirmed no work effect runs, and what was captured then stays dead
GATE-02 the context is an immutable value with explicit null study fields for document work
GATE-03 an effect runs synchronously exactly once, and cannot defer work
GATE-04 study A -> B -> A: the first A is not the second A; document work is untouched by selection
GATE-05 an edit stales editor effects only
GATE-06 a preparation blocks ordinary work; cancelling it is a new work epoch that revives nothing
GATE-07 the preparation permission is one live, frozen capture: not reusable, not forgeable, not alterable
GATE-08 the end of the session is final for the document: no late notice, cleared record or second identity reopens it
GATE-08 a replacement login never runs the old session's effects nor adopts the new identity in this document
GATE-09 lifecycle work (the closed document's own notices) follows the session and epoch, never opens work
GATE-09 every invalidating transition is announced synchronously with the state it led to
SEND-01 every request carries the session its work was captured under, and the CSRF header
SEND-12 caller Headers keep media headers and cannot override or duplicate binding
SEND-12 caller pairs keep media headers and cannot override or duplicate binding
SEND-12 caller lower-case bindings keep media headers and cannot override or duplicate binding
SEND-13 an authenticated end in headers is reported before a held error body, exactly once
SEND-14 Fetch policy survives binding, including redirect rejection on uploads
SEND-02 nothing is sent for a context that is not admitted, or without a session to bind
SEND-03 one deadline covers the headers and the body
SEND-04 a read whose context went stale is aborted; a write is not, and the gate refuses its late effect
SEND-05 the caller can cancel, before the request leaves and while it is out
SEND-06 only the server's word that the session ended or was replaced is a session-end signal
SEND-07 an explicit operation binding is carried and blamed instead of the document session
SEND-08 a success body that cannot be read is not a success envelope
SEND-09 a stream is read chunk by chunk under the same clock and the same staleness rule
SEND-10 the answer is a value: reading it later cannot be turned into an apply by the transport
SEND-11 the deadline is the request kind's: a draft command 10 s, other API work 60 s, media only what the caller gives
GATE-10 no kind of completion applies across a transition that staled its context, in either completion order
DRAFT-01 every write carries the owner, the revision it stands on and the whole snapshot; saved only on a matching envelope
DRAFT-02 a lost answer, a partial envelope or a 504: one automatic read decides - stored means saved, with no second write
DRAFT-03 an unknown outcome is never re-sent by itself; the next command reads the stored draft first
DRAFT-04 another draft on the server is a conflict: the attempt is kept, nothing is re-sent, automatic writes stop until the person decides
DRAFT-05 a conflict with this document's own late write is settled without asking: the base moves and the write goes once more
DRAFT-06 a conflict over the same content converges without a second write
DRAFT-07 a draft deleted elsewhere, a new epoch or another owner is never written over by itself
DRAFT-08 queued saves of one document merge: the waiting one is not sent, the newest goes on the confirmed revision
DRAFT-09 the preservation save is bound to its capture: saved by envelope or by a full read, rebased only onto this document's own text
DRAFT-10 discard and commit carry the same preconditions; a conflict is followed only onto this document's own text
DRAFT-11 an older revision of the same epoch is a stale observation; an operation write is not confirmed by a read
DRAFT-12 a write cut by its 10 s deadline is looked for twice at most, never re-sent, and is saved when the server finished it
DRAFT-13 a write that waited sends what its caller has when its turn comes, or nothing; the caller hears of the command before it first
DRAFT-14 a discard whose answer was lost is confirmed by a read; a commit is not (a missing draft row does not say the report changed)
DRAFT-15 a read this document overtook is stale and moves nothing; replace never moves the base back; a newer read stays a read
AUTH-01 entry asks the server once without a binding, then every request names the session
AUTH-02 no session in a document with reliable storage and no end record: the login starts by itself, once
AUTH-03 the automatic login never starts over an end record, unverifiable storage, a failed confirmation or a refused entry proof
AUTH-04 the entry proof is taken from the address at once, used once, and enters even where storage cannot be verified
AUTH-05 which answers close a document: the session ended, the session replaced - and nothing else
AUTH-06 notices are session-bound and never re-posted; storage trouble and preparation notices close nothing
AUTH-07 one logout: the record and the notice before the network, one bound POST, one move after the server's answer
AUTH-08 a logout that the server does not confirm is unconfirmed by its kind, never retried by itself, and never a confirmed end
A1: not-yet-moved page or moved page preserves every statement, byte and outer markup
A1/helper: all three split stages reconstruct the original text and enforce tags, files and markup
